value_benevolence.quote: Izuku will routinely break his arms for the sake of others, even if it's not completely necessary, such as demanding Shoto to unlock his full potential by using his fire side.

value_conformity.quote: Izuku is a quite diligent and strong-willed student, being extremely (and sometimes scarily) enthusiastic about topics related to heroes.

motive_romance.quote: Izuku realizes his feelings for Ochaco and goes looking for her, finding her alone in a crowd. He tells her that, while he respects and loves everyone, he really wants to spend more time with her now, even into the future.

egalitarian.quote: Izuku expresses pity towards All For One. He remarked that he wasn't a monster beyond understanding or even a demon lord; just a lonely man without any friends, something that ultimately proved to be true.

principled_at_cost.quote: Izuku is known to help or lecture people with personal and emotional problems, regardless of if it's his business or not, claiming that a hero should meddle in other people's lives.

visible_scars.quote: After his battle against Shoto Todoroki, the fingers on his right hand became slightly deformed, and his hand shows visible scarring. His right arm was further damaged after his intense fight with Muscular, leaving many more scars.

muscular_build.quote: Though he was initially very skinny, Izuku has gained toned muscles after his ten months of extensive training with All Might, and as the series progresses, these are shown to become more developed and defined as he gradually grows stronger.

distinctive_feature.quote: His eyes are large and somewhat circular and his irises are the same shade of green as his hair, which at times are very watery, and are usually stretched quite wide, giving him an innocent, energized appearance.

cares_about_appearance.quote: Izuku's first hero costume, known as "Costume Alpha", was made by his mother. It was a light green full-body jumpsuit with a red belt, black elbow pads and knee pads, and white gloves, along with his signature red boots.

charismatic.quote: Izuku is one of the main motivators within his class alongside Katsuki, thanks to a combination of his heroic drive and practical intellect.

physical_weakness.quote: Even so, he still possessed impressive physical durability, and his drive allowed him to withstand the drawbacks of One For All for the most part.
